                                  IN THE UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
                                  FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA
                                             Alexandria Division


   MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE                               )
                                                        )
                                                        )
                     Plaintiff,                         )
                                                        )
   v.                                                   )   Civil Action No. 1:26-cv-2331-(RDA/IDD)
                                                        )
   KATIE HALL, et al.,                                  )
                                                        )
                                                        )
                     Defendants.                        )
                                                        )

                                                   ORDER

          This matter is before the Court on Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to Appear Remotely at the

September 25, 2026 Hearing [Dkt. No. 41] (“Motion”). This matter can be resolved without oral argument,

as such argument would not aid the decisional process. Upon consideration of Motion, it is hereby

          ORDERED that Plaintiff’s Motion is DENIED AS MOOT. The Court previously granted

Plaintiff’s Notice of Withdrawal of ECF No. 26 [Dkt. Nos. 57-58] and Plaintiff’s Request to vacate the

September 25, 2026 Hearing [Dkt. Nos. 57-28], and thus, oral argument as to Plaintiff’s Withdrawn

Motion [Dkt. No. 26] is not necessary; It is further

          ORDERED that the September 25, 2026 Motion Hearing on Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to Serve

Three Limited Interrogatories on NCMEC before the Rule 26(f) Conference (“Plaintiff’s Interrogatories

Motion”) [Dkt. No. 15] at 10:00 AM in Courtroom 301 is TERMINATED. The undersigned deems a

Motion hearing is not necessary and will resolve Plaintiff’s Interrogatories Motion on the papers; It is

further

          ORDERED that, should any party utilize generative artificial intelligence for the preparation of

any filing submitted to this Court, that party must identify the use of the generative artificial intelligence

in the filing as well as provide a certification that said party has reviewed all citations for accuracy.

          The Clerk is directed to forward a copy of this Order to all counsel of record.
